cd /tmp && python3 -I -c '
import sys, random
ws = [chr(c) for c in range(sys.maxunicode+1) if chr(c).isspace()]
print("whitespace chars:", len(ws), [hex(ord(c)) for c in ws])
provider = lambda v: v.strip()          # protocol.md: v1 and v2 string rule
old = lambda s: provider(s)             # old client sent raw string
new = lambda s: provider(s.strip())     # new client pre-strips
pool = ws + list("Ada  Lovelacé\U0001F600") + ["​", "﻿"]
random.seed(0)
bad = 0
for _ in range(200000):
    s = "".join(random.choice(pool) for _ in range(random.randint(0, 8)))
    if old(s) != new(s): bad += 1
for c in ws: assert old(c*3) == new(c*3) == ""
print("mismatches:", bad)
# payload type/shape unchanged, null never produced for str input
print(type(new("  ")), repr(new("  ")))
'; ls /usr/bin/python3* /opt/homebrew/bin/python3.* 2>/dev/null
